logo_rule: Use the exact original Pro-pre logo asset from the site. Never redraw, reinterpret or replace it.
style_rules: Rounded cards and buttons consistent with pro-pre.com
Clean sans-serif typography matching the site
VOISIN20 promo may use yellow pill/badge
Client-facing graphics must look like a direct extension of pro-pre.com
forbidden: dark teal/petrol green as primary brand color
invented client data, dates, prices, addresses, slogans or claims

generation_policy.critical_text_and_logo: Prefer deterministic HTML/CSS/document layout over generative image rendering.
generation_policy.image_generation: Decorative/non-critical imagery only; never let image generation recreate the Pro-pre logo or critical text.

change_control.rule: Do not change the Pro-pre visual identity unless Claudio explicitly requests a brand change.
